items.titulo: Google Open-Sources Mantis: A Modular Skills Toolkit That Lets Coding Agents Find, Reproduce and Patch Vulnerabilities
items.resumen: Google has open-sourced Mantis, a stack-agnostic toolkit of security review skills for AI coding agents. It runs the full vulnerability lifecycle: sweep the code, filter false positives, reproduce the bug in a sandbox, patch it, re-attack the patch, then score the risk. Apache 2.0, and documented as demonstration-only.
